attr.title: Tinymon
attr.desc: Delve into an isekai world full of tiny monsters ready to battle, learn a new language on the way, and explore the land of Tinymon! A refreshing but retro take on the monster-taming genre.
attr.inst: Buy the game on Steam and copy all the data to `ports/tinymon/assets`. The patcher will run whenever it finds new files in the assets folder.
